These JSON files capture actual original money-owner definitions read from the
configured production Supabase connection on 2026-11-16. The native PG17 run
recreates them and verifies each PostgreSQL `pg_get_functiondef` MD5 before
installing prospective source. Captures contain source, no records or secrets.

The regression executes the original promo ticket send/batch refusal and old
receipt replay, the original ticket owner with cashable player/agent sources,
agent-source cancellation and replay, the actual wallet debit primitive,
per-entry principal, partial prizes/refunds, earned satellite rollover, full
loss and the private five-per-day Free Buy book. Actual original Free Buy
bounty/head and cutoff funding owners create source-ledger-backed coupon face
slices. Coupon allowance alone creates no grant; guarantee zero/fractional/large
subsidies and exact aggregate cents preserve the original funding formulas. Bought tickets never create
new promo custody or a new play-through target.

Fixture adapters are explicit: journal legs replace production autoledger and
tally, the registration wrapper calls the actual debit primitive, the actual fee migration prefix records immutable original entry funding
and prices its payable contract, and principal return records intent and retires
custody. The lock-only source-fund adapter has no real fund journal. This proof
does not qualify the production tally, full tournament entry accounting,
original exact-refund closure or source-fund concurrency; the combined owning
financial integration must qualify those before programme activation.

Free Buy escrow updates and guarantee-funding reads are explicit isolated
adapters. The actual original head/cutoff functions and their promo source
balance debit, immutable journal, replay keys and pool update run unchanged.
This is not a full production guarantee/escrow closure claim.

The native run loads the actual private inventory-pin owner captured by the
custody dependency, preserving its owner-only ACL. Union coupon principal
uses the original registration wallet club and survives lawful registration
deletion as immutable funding evidence.

The current purchase-owner capture preserves the original direct rebuy/reentry/
addon wallet debit and updates only its existing admission-body pin. The bust
capture retains the actual accepted-hand and complete-bounty-marker owners.
The narrow fixture compiles these definitions; actual monetary reentry and
source-fund returns require the full original financial closure proof.
Original expense receipts freeze entrant/earning club independently of refund
wallet destination and use the original financial transaction clock. Both
same-transaction fee/gift orders, true-zero funding, exact 4× completion,
partial/full canonical fee reversals and terminal loss before a later gift are
qualified without treating delayed commission recognition as the paid clock.
